title: Coherent excitation of a two-state system by a Lorentzian field
summary: We study the coherent excitation of a two-state quantum system by a field with a Lorentzian temporal envelope and constant carrier frequency. The associated differential equation admits an exact local representation in terms of confluent Heun functions. For the transition probability we develop a Dykhne-Davis-Pechukas (DDP) description based on the two relevant complex transition points and their interference.
